scripts.//dev: `pnpm dev` starts web and server together but Vite is up ~4s first, so without this it proxies /api into a backend that hasn't booted. turbo can't express this: persistent tasks can't be depended on, and `with` doesn't wait. Trailing `;` not `&&`: a missing API should still let you do UI-only work. Target must match server.proxy in vite.config.ts.
scripts.//settle-proof: Acceptance harness for the settle rule in src/lib/settle.ts: frame-by-frame proof that nothing flashes. Needs the dev stack up (pnpm dev + pnpm dev:zero-cache) and a browser: `npx playwright install chromium` once.
scripts.//drawer-proof: Acceptance harness for BASE_UI_PLAN.md §8: the detail drawer's geometry on both form factors, and the dark-mode overlay contrast the migration put at risk. Same prerequisites as settle-proof; seeds its own items.
scripts.//start: Production static serving (Railway). -s is the SPA fallback: without it a hard refresh on /item/<id> 404s.
